# Named Entity Recognition

Extracts named entities such as persons, organizations, and locations from text.

## Usage
- Identifies and classifies entities: PERSON, ORG, LOC, DATE, MONEY, etc.
- Returns entity spans with character offsets and confidence scores
- Supports custom entity types via fine-tuned models
- Outputs structured JSON for easy downstream processing
